text:
maria-ae: Quick one — prospect AuroraHealth signed for 12mo committed Dedicated (50k/mo) but needs a non-standard invoicing cadence. They want: 40% upfront, then 3 milestone invoices over the next 6 months (equal), remainder Net45. Can we get Deal Desk / Finance ok for this split?
jon-dealdesk: @maria-ae can you drop the exact amounts and legal entity ? Also any credit approval notes from underwriting?
maria-ae: Sure — total ARR = $600k. Upfront = $240k, milestones = $120k each for month 3, 6, 9 (so 3 x $120k = $360k), then final true-up $0 at month 12 (we structured so milestones cover remainder). Customer legal entity = Aurora Health Systems, Inc. Underwriting did soft credit check, no flags, but CFO asked for PO and Bill-to entity split across two subsidiaries.
frank-finance: Splitting invoices across two subsidiaries is fine operationally but needs GL mapping. We usually avoid >2 invoice entities on one contract. Who is asking for split, customer or internal procurement?
lisa-csm: Customer procurement requested split for budget reasons — 60% to AH Ops (upfront + milestone 1), 40% to AH Research (milestone 2 + 3). They provided two POs.
jon-dealdesk: Ok. From Deal Desk side: we can approve 40% upfront + milestone schedule, but need: (1) signed SOW amendment capturing the invoice schedule, (2) CFO email approving net terms for second entity, (3) confirmation underwriting OK with split. Also need to confirm we accept Net45 on last payment — that deviates from standard Net30 for committed deals.
frank-finance: Net45 is acceptable for enterprise if revenue ops signs off. We'll need AR to set terms and update payment reminders. Also request for Net45 increases DSO — please ensure sales crediting and commission timeline handled.
anya-legal: Two legal notes: (a) amendment must include a single Master Agreement reference and list both Bill-to entities with tax IDs, (b) we need to ensure indemnity and data residency clauses remain unchanged. If one entity fails to pay, which entity bears liability? Need explicit language.
devon-se: From SE side — technical onboarding will require access tokens scoped per org. If billing entities are split we might need separate tenancy mapping in Dedicated to align cost centers. That’s low risk but needs ops tickets.
maria-ae: Underwriting says they can accept split but wants guarantees on invoice references. Customer offered ACH for upfront; later milestones via two POs (AH-OPS-PO and AH-RES-PO).
invoice-bot: New invoice request recorded: ticket INV-2029-447. Assigned to AR-team.
jon-dealdesk: Decision path: I can approve the schedule conditionally. Please get: (1) amendment with schedule and liability clause, (2) CFO confirmation email for Net45, (3) POs attached. Finance to confirm GL mapping, Legal to approve amendment language.
frank-finance: We can provisionally accept. Please route a short form GL mapping spreadsheet to AR@redwood.com. AR will set two invoice recipients, and we'll set final due date rules for Net45.
anya-legal: I'll draft a one-paragraph amendment template and post here in thread for sign-off.
maria-ae: I'll collect POs and CFO email today. ETA EOD PST. Thanks — tagging @devon-se so he can open the ops ticket after amendment signs.
devon-se: Got it. I'll prepare tenancy mapping checklist and include steps to avoid token bleed.
lisa-csm: Customer happy with the cadence as long as milestones align to delivery checkpoints. I'll coordinate milestone acceptance criteria with them.
jon-dealdesk: Great — once we have docs and CFO email I'll mark as "Approved - conditional" and queue contract for signature. :thumbsup:
maria-ae: Thanks team — will update when I have the POs and email.
invoice-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow up in 3 days if docs not uploaded.
maria-ae: (follow-up) Uploaded POs to the deal record and pasted CFO email below. CFO confirms Net45 for AH Research entity only; AH Ops remains Net30. Need Deal Desk to confirm that's acceptable.
jon-dealdesk: Hmm split net terms across entities is a new wrinkle — we prefer consistent terms across the contract. @frank-finance any blocker if AH-RES is Net45 and AH-OPS Net30?
frank-finance: We can manage different terms per bill-to but AR automation may need manual override. Still acceptable operationally. Approving given POs and credit check.
anya-legal: Add clause: "Each Bill-to entity shall be responsible for payment of invoices issued to it; non-payment by one entity does not automatically excuse the other’s obligations unless expressly stated." That should protect Redwood.
jon-dealdesk: With legal/finance thumbs up, approved. Please attach amendment and route for signature. Closing conditional approval. :white_check_mark:
note: No title field included per agents.md
